title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I am writing to you again to kindly request your ruling on a Khula that has been issued in my marriage. I had emailed you long ago but did not receive a response. I'll appreciate your quick response for this attempt. My wife had conducted herself in questionable manner during the initial 5 months of our marriage. She was careless about expenses and her social life. I requested her to control herself but she mostly responded with anger as she was brought up with complete freedom of her parents, who also expected me to change for her unconditionally. Noticing that I was unwilling to change for her, she isolated herself and overanalyzed our marriage before approaching an Imam and requested a Khula...??? 3535 views Q. Is divorce valid if sent by an email. 2049 views Q. Clarification on Marital Status in case Husband siad Tum Azad Ho 4354 views Q. I am Asghar and I got married 2 years back and I have a daughter who is one year old now. My wife has applied for Khula (divorce) in local Jamat (Mosque) 1821 views Q. My sister who is 4 years married is tortured emotionally,mentally by her husband & Inlaws.Her husband is unemployed from 3&1/2 years.He doesn't seems to be reformed when we try to settle.My sister says I will not go to his house otherwise I will suicide.Husband refuse to give Talaq.Can she take "khula".We don't want to go Court.Can u suggest any Darul Qaza in UP(near Aligarh) & DELHI.How much time it will take & what will happen if her husband doesn't come by sermon from Darul Qaza. 2441 views Q. If a wife desert her husband, running away from her matrimonial house and going to another country along with the child and there file for divorce after two months. She still has any rights on her child even the father deny to give divorce and the court award her divorce. 1872 views Q. When wife and husband want to take divorce then who has to take the responsibility of their children,wife or husband?wife says i want my children and husband says i want my children.if the children are given to wife as per her wish,is it necessary for the husband to pay maintenance to the wife to take care of the children.what does islam say? plaese kindly reply. 2121 views Q. My niece Sayeeda Nadaf, was married to Basheer Shaikh, in the year 2002. He stayed for a week and disappeared 2016 views Q. Fake case after Talaqnama was sent 2786 views Q. About dovorce 5045 views Q. Custody of Son after Talaq 4343 views Q. I want to ask you about very important Issue that relate to Separation after marriage. Scenario: This Issue relates to one of my relative (a woman). She Married 3.5 years ago but unfortunately, after 2nd month of her marriage, her husband cheat her and left her without giving her talaq. After one year she became a mother of a beautiful Daughter. She took her baby to him and showed him his Daughter, 1st he denied to accept that she is his daughter but after some emotional arguments between them he accepted and believed her that he will give their rights, but he didn?t do so. He escaped again and never came back. Now, her Daughter is 2.5 year Old but there is no sign of him. She don?t know, whether he is alive or dead. My Questions are: ? Is the Nikha is still valid. ? If that Woman wants to do another Marriage, how could she do as she doesn?t even know her husband address or anything about him? ? How the separation/talaq/divorce can take place? ? How would she start a new marriage life? Kindly help her by giving her a proper advice. I?ll be very thankful to you. 1795 views Q. Talaq pronounced to wife over phone without witness & without knowledge of her hayees who left house without my permission 9 months ago for no reason 6038 views Q. In a marriage contract of a couple, it is written "The wife is permitted to divorce her husband". 1899 views Q. Talaq 7137 views
answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 14646 Country: India Title: Assalamu alaikum warahmatullah. Janab Mufti sahab, I Md. A.H. Dabaka married Mst. R.B.Dhekiajuly on 31/08/08 I marred according to Islamic law. I and my wife love each other very much. But her parents do not like me. So they, by any means, want Divorce. Some days ago her parents in my absence took her to their home with false vows. After that they put pressure on her for divorce. Accordingly, she wanted divorce. But I did not it. I only replied in Assamese through SMS (TUMI JI AKARE MUK ERI JABO BISARISA TAR KARONE MOI TUMAK TALAQ DIA JORURI, KINTU, TUMAR NISINA TUMAR PORIALE U BISARILE MOI TALAQ DIBOLOI RAJI ASU) {Translate to English} ?whatever you have wanted,?? It is necessary for me to divorce you. If your family wants like you, I am ready?. On another day I told her, ?if you go to your parental house without my wish, I shall divorce you? Has it become divorce? I love her and will love for ever. They have forcefully want to got her married to another person. Is not this an act against Islamic law? In hope for answer from your side. ZAZAK ALLAH. Question: Assalamu alaikum warahmatullah. Janab Mufti sahab, I Md. A.H. Dabaka married Mst. R.B.Dhekiajuly on 31/08/08 I marred according to Islamic law. I and my wife love each other very much. But her parents do not like me. So they, by any means, want Divorce. Some days ago her parents in my absence took her to their home with false vows. After that they put pressure on her for divorce. Accordingly, she wanted divorce. But I did not it. I only replied in Assamese through SMS (TUMI JI AKARE MUK ERI JABO BISARISA TAR KARONE MOI TUMAK TALAQ DIA JORURI, KINTU, TUMAR NISINA TUMAR PORIALE U BISARILE MOI TALAQ DIBOLOI RAJI ASU) {Translate to English} ?whatever you have wanted,?? It is necessary for me to divorce you. If your family wants like you, I am ready?. On another day I told her, ?if you go to your parental house without my wish, I shall divorce you? Has it become divorce? I love her and will love for ever. They have forcefully want to got her married to another person. Is not this an act against Islamic law? In hope for answer from your side. ZAZAK ALLAH. Answer ID: 14646 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1326/1076=D/1430) In the SMS ? whatever you have wanted??It is necessary for me to divorce you. If your family wants like you, I am ready? there is no word of talaq. While saying to her: ?if you go to your parental house without my wish, I shall divorce you? is also not talaq, rather warning. Therefore, no talaq will take place by these two sentences. If you said any other sentence as well, you should write it clearly. When there was no talaq, you Mst. R.B. Dhekiajuly is your wife, her nikah with other man is invalid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
